art.title: The Night Watch
art.credit: Public domain · image via Wikimedia Commons (Rijksmuseum)
art.story: Amsterdam's citizen guards march out from under an arch: the captain in black, with a red sash and tall boots, gives the order, a drum rolls, lances and a musket bristle, and a small girl in gold glows among them with a chicken tied to her belt, the company's sign. Group portraits usually lined people up in rows; Rembrandt made his a moment of movement instead. It isn't even night: the scene went dark under old varnish. The painting is huge, and was once cut down at the edges to fit a wall.
